message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: burglary/attempted theft. The defendant broke into a residence, attempted theft but did not obtain property. That's burglary (illegal entry with intent to commit theft). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "盗窃未遂" (theft attempt) or "入室盗窃罪" (burglary). The examples: For theft attempts, they label as "盗窃". In earlier example: "盗窃;非法持有毒品" they used "盗窃" for theft. For burglary they used "失火" etc. There's no separate burglary label; they use "盗窃". So answer likely "盗窃". Also mention "未遂"? In examples they didn't add "未遂". They just list the crime name. So output: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "非法侵入住宅"? But not in list. So answer.
